label: M1 the accumulator is never cleared (0x100dbe44 dropped) - the sentinel in +0x10 must not survive
M2 the two field registers are swapped, so the answer and the zero land on each other's field (0x100dbe37/0x100dbe3b)
find:
g->ecx = seconds_field; /* 0x100dbe37 */
    g->edx = ms_field;      /* 0x100dbe3b - and what the entry hands back in edx */
replace:
g->ecx = ms_field;      /* MUTANT: the two arguments exchanged */
    g->edx = seconds_field;

label: M3 the answer is not stored at all, only cleared (0x100dbe42 dropped)
M4 the returned eax is tidied to 1 instead of masked into al (0x100dbe4a writes AL alone, so states 1/2/4 keep the answer's upper bytes)
M5 the entry's own `add esp,4` at 0x100dbe3f is dropped, so the callee's argument is left on the stack and the esp at the return is 4 low
find: g->esp += 4u; /* 0x100dbe3f: add esp,4 - the callee is cdecl and left its argument behind */

label: M6 the out-parameter push at 0x100dbe30 is dropped (the call still happens, so the call count agrees and only esp differs)
find:
g->esp -= 4u; /* 0x100dbe30: push 0 - the query's out-parameter, unused */
    wr32(g->esp, 0u);

label: M7 edx is left as the caller had it (the entry loads it at 0x100dbe3b and hands it back)
find: g->edx = ms_field;      /* 0x100dbe3b - and what the entry hands back in edx */
